blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Direct Possible, not Yes: exact verified SparkVault implementations expose ordinary ERC-20 share transfers and no active holder blacklist/freeze or arbitrary-holder burn, but _authorizeUpgrade is restricted to assigned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. At ethereum@26224762 (2026-10-19T06:14:35+00:00, hash 0xef45b71f129dac5f794f4506dee4ca47f3cdd7e41c6e75f53d66512c8c505fc5), Ethereum spUSDC 0x28b3a8fb53b741a8fd78c0fb9a6b2393d896a43d uses implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455; getRoleMemberCount(bytes32(0))=1 and getRoleMember(0,0)=0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4 (the existing Spark/Sky governance review identifies the SubProxy/48-hour DSPause path). At xlayer@73621689 (2026-10-19T06:18:45+00:00, hash 0xc9b913e415700edec90708aeacc6b06ef6454535784a9a626be7720cfb820cbc), issuer-documented X Layer spUSDC 0xf90e63079d97a0a1f479b2b168457f420caff6ba, missing from the prior authored contract list/census, uses exact-match implementation 0xdce929a335c75a1676ef5957a4d7a3b928c48820 and has one nonzero DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, 0xcf5af6f53cec74b791cb4182ac778ca9cd323510; its signing architecture is not inferred. totalAssets() values are 298,054,049.018072 USDC on Ethereum, 92,214,073.038816 on X Layer and 1,989,061.353980 on Avalanche at block 97944254, respectively 75.9843%, 23.5086% and 0.5071% of the measured $392,257,183.410868 aggregate across these three issuer-listed vaults [INFERENCE: NAV-weighted deployment supply proxy]. Both material implementations are therefore mutable even under DAO governance; the collateral DAO carve-out does not apply to token upgrades. Peripheral Avalanche implementation 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12 has sole admin 0x7566debc906c17338524a414343fa61bca26a843. asset() returns local USDC on all three, preserving the previously pinned 2026-10-01 USDC-asset relationship and underlying Circle freeze exposure; it does not establish that deployed strategies all hold USDC. The historical reserve rows measure 3.2579% idle USDC and 96.7421% unresolved deployed strategy claims, not a measured current issuer-freezable majority. Parent exposure remains secondary; direct upgradeability sets Possible.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The tracked Ethereum and Avalanche spUSDC deployments are local ERC-4626 USDC vaults behind upgradeable ERC-1967 UUPS proxies, not immutable clones. Pinned reads on 2026-10-01 confirm local USDC assets and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders Spark SubProxy on Ethereum and Spark executor on Avalanche. Wrapper upgrades remain in Mint Authority; these local share contracts are not Avalanche Bridge representations.

routes.reviewNote: At Ethereum block 26095794 on 2026-10-01, the ERC-1967 implementation slot returned 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455 and the correct EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. This is a UUPS proxy: a zero transparent-admin slot does not imply immutability. Spark's source restricts upgrades to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, whose member at index 0 was Spark SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. asset() returned Ethereum USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Local share issuance and its upgrade authority are recorded in Mint Authority.

At Avalanche block 96511142 on 2026-10-01, the ERC-1967 implementation slot returned 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12 and the correct EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. This is an upgradeable UUPS proxy, with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member at index 0 Spark executor 0x7566debc906c17338524a414343fa61bca26a843. The official registry identifies its LayerZero receiver as 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F. asset() returned native USDC 0xb97ef9ef8734c71904d8002f8b6bc66dd9c48a6e. Local share issuance and its upgrade authority are recorded in Mint Authority.
